description: Registers (or, with pub all zeros, revokes) the owner's X25519 delivery key: signature is the account owner's EIP-712 signature over the typed data delivery_key_typed_data returns, checked against owner() on chain; issuedAt must be newer than the registered key's and at most 5 minutes ahead; a low-order key is refused; at most 5 keys a UTC day per account (a revoke is always taken). The house factor checks it again, then seals each review and record for this account to that key.

account.description: The factor account's 0x address (open_account returns it). Accounts are found by address, never by agentId.

name: register_delivery_key
title: House factor reviews: register the delivery key
